summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 9.5 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys). Demonstrated the required failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss (confirmed via matching WAL LSNs before failover), repointed node3 to follow node2 via timeline-following recovery, then rebuilt node1 as a standby of node2 using pg_basebackup. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), confirming changed boot IDs and full replication/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql 9.5 + contrib on node1, node2, node3
Generated replication role password on node1 via openssl inside sudo -u postgres context, stored root-only
Created 'replicator' REPLICATION LOGIN role on node1
Configured node1 postgresql.conf (listen_addresses, wal_level=hot_standby, max_wal_senders, wal_keep_segments, hot_standby) and pg_hba.conf for replication access from all three nodes
Bootstrapped node2 and node3 as standbys via pg_basebackup -R against node1, applied matching postgresql.conf/pg_hba.conf, started services
Verified initial streaming replication and baseline row propagation (rows 1-3) to both standbys
Verified pre-failover WAL LSN match between node1 and node2 confirming zero-data-loss readiness
Stopped postgresql on node1 to simulate primary loss
Promoted node2 via pg_ctl promote; confirmed pg_is_in_recovery=false
Wrote new row on node2 as new primary; verified it
Repointed node3's recovery.conf to node2 with recovery_target_timeline='latest', confirmed it received all data including post-failover row
Rebuilt node1 via pg_basebackup -R against node2 with recovery_target_timeline='latest', confirmed it rejoined as standby with full data
Verified node2 pg_stat_replication shows both node1 and node3 streaming
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes
Rebooted node3 (standby) first; polled until reachable; verified changed boot_id and full standby recovery with data intact
Rebooted node1 (standby) second; verified changed boot_id and full standby recovery with data intact
Rebooted node2 (primary) last after confirming both standbys still streaming; verified changed boot_id, primary status, and data intact
Post-restart: confirmed both standbys reconnected as streaming, inserted verification row on primary, confirmed propagation to both standbys

evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL streaming replication cluster established: node1 primary, node2 and node3 standbys
evidence.summary: node1 active as primary with pg_stat_replication showing node2 and node3 streaming; both standbys confirmed pg_is_in_recovery=true

evidence.requirement: Data written on primary replicates to both standbys
evidence.summary: Rows inserted on node1 (baseline rows 1-2) appear identically on node2 and node3 after replication

evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
evidence.summary: Pre-failover row 3 WAL LSN matched exactly between node1 and node2 before primary was stopped; node2 promoted to primary (pg_is_in_recovery=false) and accepted new write (row 4) with zero data loss

evidence.requirement: Remaining standby (node3) continues/rejoins replication from new primary
evidence.summary: node3 repointed to node2 with recovery_target_timeline=latest, successfully streamed and shows all 4 rows including post-failover row 4

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of current primary (node2)
evidence.summary: node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup against node2, entered recovery mode, replicated all data including post-failover row; node2 pg_stat_replication confirms both node1 and node3 streaming

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence - node3 baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: node3 boot_id changed from f41e1f8a...to f90ffd39... after systemctl reboot; postgresql active, pg_is_in_recovery=true, all 4 rows intact post-restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence - node1 baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: node1 boot_id changed from 847a859d...to 120d9369... after systemctl reboot; postgresql active, pg_is_in_recovery=true, all 4 rows intact post-restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence - node2 (primary) baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovered as primary with quorum
evidence.summary: node2 boot_id changed from e881ab3c...to 5826aab2... after systemctl reboot; came back as writable primary (pg_is_in_recovery=false) with data intact, both standbys reconnected as streaming, new write (post-restart-verification row) accepted

evidence.requirement: Final cluster-wide data consistency after all restarts
evidence.summary: Both node1 and node3 show count=5 rows matching node2 primary after full restart cycle and new insert
